Definition: A provider or SDK adapter behind Chirality-owned contracts where provider-specific terms, events, sessions, permission modes, and tool names are translated.
A concrete integration layer for an external agent provider or SDK; current shipped concrete adapter is Claude Agent SDK / Anthropic.
A reference corpus for stable agentic patterns observed in Pi packages and behavior; not a runtime dependency, adapter target, fork target, or package import path.
Chirality policy deciding which tools/capabilities are exposed and executable per session, persona, mode, provider adapter, and validation state.
A hard-deny rule overriding allows at reliance, secret, protected-path, professional, destructive-action, or unvalidated-expansion boundaries; replaces blanket deny-first posture.
The approved runtime direction: provider-adapter-general, contract-owned, and Chirality-governed, with external provider SDKs supplying agent-loop mechanics only behind Chirality adapters.
